title: Show that dividing by W does not bound the normalized recurrence
body:
## Summary
- The transfer review proves `F(e) <= A e^tau` when `Psi(tau) < 1`. The factor `1/W` is the normalization named in the audit.
- Four children of width 2, two roles and modulus 4 satisfy `1 <= t < m`. At `tau = 1/2`, the square of Psi is 2. The recurrence equals 3 at width 8, and `9 > 8`.
- One child of width 1, four roles and modulus 4 has Psi `1/8` and stays within allowance `8/7` through width 64. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
